name: Foreman Thistlenettle
summary: In the Deadmines, Foreman Thistlenettle once led a dwarven mining crew. He worked for both the Miners' League and the Explorers' League until a cave-in trapped his crew below Moonbrook. He died with them and rose again as a ghoul, still carrying his guild badge through the dark, collapsed tunnels.

sections.title: A Brother's Grief
sections.body: Wilder Thistlenettle, Foreman Thistlenettle's brother, has waited in Stormwind for word of the missing crew. With the tunnels occupied, no news came from below. Rumors now say the fallen foreman walks among the dead. Travelers near the Deadmines are asked to find him, end his torment, and recover his badge for his grieving brother.

sections.title: Tragedy in the Deadmines
sections.body: Before the Defias Brotherhood took full control of the Deadmines, mining crews worked its rich veins. Foreman Thistlenettle led one such expedition for the Miners' League and the Explorers' League. Deep beneath Moonbrook, a violent cave-in sealed his party away from the surface. The miners died in the darkness, but did not remain at rest. A necrotic taint raised Thistlenettle and his crew as ravenous ghouls, stalking the shadowed passages.

faq.q: Who was Foreman Thistlenettle before he died?
faq.answer: Foreman Thistlenettle was a dwarf who worked with both the Miners' League and the Explorers' League. Before outlaws fully fortified the Deadmines, he led miners there to excavate and survey its underground veins.

faq.q: Why is Foreman Thistlenettle an undead ghoul?
faq.answer: A cave-in buried Foreman Thistlenettle and his mining party, killing them. Dark energies or lingering necromancy in the mines then animated their remains as restless ghouls.
Foreman Thistlenettle haunts a dead-end, collapsed tunnel in the Deadmines' outer maze, before the portal to its inner depths. His former miners, now ghouls, surround him.

faq.q: Who is looking for Foreman Thistlenettle?
faq.answer: Wilder Thistlenettle, Foreman Thistlenettle's brother, seeks proof of his fate. Wilder lives in Stormwind City's Dwarven District and asks travelers to bring back Thistlenettle's Badge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the loss of an Explorers' League foreman and his crew shows the dangers beneath the human kingdoms.
As a miner, you know tunnel collapses and hostile depths can make every descent perilous.
